methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15: timetastic.co.uk/pricing/, www.leavedates.com/pricing-plans, vacationtracker.io/pricing/ (+ /security), calamari.io/pricing (+ /security), www.absence.io/en/packages-pricing/, leaveboard.com/pricing/, timeoff.management/pricing, flamingoapp.com/pricing/ (+ billing FAQ support.flamingoapp.com/article/50-billing-faq), and www.getpause.com/. Corrections applied: Timetastic base plan renamed 'Standard'->'Timetastic' (official label); Calamari gained the omitted 'Performance Review' module ($3/$2.50); Leave Dates Plus had guessed GBP per-user figures (from search results, not the official dynamic page) removed; Flamingo's $3/user/month confirmed via FAQ example '20 x $3 = $60' despite a '$30' display label on the marketing page. GBP-only (Timetastic, Leave Dates) and EUR-only (absence.io) plans keep monthlyUsd=null to avoid currency-conversion guesses. PurelyHR remains quote-only (page renders '-- USD' placeholders). Telephony fields are null throughout (these are leave-management SaaS, not call products). A NULL BEATS A GUESS was applied to all enterprise/contact-sales tiers and undisclosed currency conversions. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
